nameOverride.description: Replaces the chart name in resource names and labels

fullnameOverride.description: Replaces the name of the app's resources (MongoDB's get the suffix -mongodb)

host_name.description: Public host name of the app

config.description: App config overriding the base config in the image

image.description: MongoDB image, pinned to a minor version

existingSecret.description: Secret with the MongoDB credentials; required if authentication is enabled

podSecurityContext.description: Security context of the pod (runAsUser, runAsGroup and fsGroup are omitted on OpenShift)

securityContext.description: Security context of the container (runAsUser and runAsGroup are omitted on OpenShift)

enabled.description: Create an Ingress; otherwise an OpenShift Route, if the cluster serves route.openshift.io/v1

className.description: Ingress class; the cluster's default class if empty

annotations.description: Annotations of the Ingress; take precedence over those set for https

enabled.description: Request a certificate from cert-manager and serve HTTPS

podSecurityContext.description: Security context of the pod (runAsUser, runAsGroup and fsGroup are omitted on OpenShift)

securityContext.description: Security context of the container (runAsUser and runAsGroup are omitted on OpenShift)
